channel.title: Epic Fury Live — US-Iran War Tracker
channel.description: Live tracking of the US-Israel-Iran conflict. Real-time updates, verified casualties, evidence, and analysis.

item.title: Manipur musician killed in Indian capital, reviving racism concerns
item.description: The guitarist's killing leads to an outcry, exposing decades of racial discrimination faced by northeastern communities.

item.title: Qatar says reopening Strait of Hormuz ‘unconditionally’ is a priority
item.description: Qatar's Foreign Ministry says Doha working towards diplomatic solutions to end US war on Iran.

item.title: BRICS summit may be the only place another Iran ceasefire can be built
item.description: Its members and partners have brokered every ceasefire so far and hold the relationships needed to build the next one.

item.title: Saudi-Houthi fighting in Yemen escalates: What happened, and what’s next?
item.description: Saudi Arabia promises firm retaliation after Houthi strikes injure 73 and disrupt energy facilities in southern cities.

item.title: Israeli forces kill Palestinian man and withhold his body near Nablus
item.description: Israeli forces shot and killed a Palestinian man amid raids and arrests across the occupied West Bank.

item.title: Saudi political analyst says ‘No prolonged war with the Houthis’
item.description: Khaled Batarfi, a Saudi political analyst, says the war with the Houthis will not be ‘prolonged’.

item.title: How South Korea finds itself trapped in the US-Iran war
item.description: Washington is pressuring a reluctant Seoul to support its naval blockade of Iran; Tehran is threatening consequences.

item.title: Houthi attacks on southern Saudi Arabia reportedly injure dozens
item.description: Saudi Arabia says a wave of Houthi attacks on the country’s south have injured 73 people, including women and children.

item.title: As fuel prices rise again, Iran’s government urges citizens to cut back
item.description: New fuel pricing targets consumption above 110 litres monthly, doubling costs to 100,000 riyals per litre.

item.title: Yemen fighting live: Battles rage between Houthi and Saudi-backed forces
item.description: Forces loyal to Yemen’s internationally recognised government pledge to seize the capital Sanaa as battles rage.
